title: Evaluation of a gate
statement: For every natural number $\ell$, every Boolean function $p$ on Boolean vectors indexed by $\{0,\ldots,\ell-1\}$, every map $\mathrm{wire}:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and every Boolean assignment $a$ on the natural numbers, the gate evaluates to $p$ applied to the vector whose value at index $i$ is $a(\mathrm{wire}(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on vectors indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(\ell)$
A Boolean assignment on the natural numbers
